Should your nation prioritize urban development or rural preservation?

[i]This is an automated message.[/i][/quote]
[i][b]Urban Development[/b]

Urban Development
Yes, the Democratic Federation of Indonocaismnic is committed to sustainable urbanization, with a focus on coexisting with nature. The nation has launched the Go-Green Project, which has the objective of integrating green spaces, such as parks and vertical gardens, into urban areas. The projects aim to improve the quality of the air, provide a habitat for wildlife, and make the environment supported for citizens. With a focus on the environment, the project seeks to make cities appear green, like vibrant "green vegetables," and respond to the ecological and social imperatives of a world that is urbanizing. The Go-Green Project aims to bring the economy to the city like Investor and tourism into the country's wealth. As well as building fast railway transport into cities with a focus on improving sustainable population needs and growth. Democratic Federation of Indonocaismnic is a fast growing city and it needs to improve the population's well-being as well as the economy to be sustainable for the nation's needs.

[/i]

[b]Coastal Barrage[/b]
In the middle of the night, on 18th March, the 8th fleet set sail from port Ğülak. They spent 2 days travelling through the Amaralo ocean, through the Argos strait and finally arriving in the southern side of the Balwick sea. Through the journey, the crew of the UHS Odyssey had been preparing the ships multiple missile launchers. The plan was to send a barrage of missiles into Sal-Baliz territory, from the coast. However, it didnt quite go according to plan.

In the early hours of March 21st, the crew of the Odyssey were woken up early. Alarm bells rang throughout the ship as a Sal-Baliz vessel rapidly approached. *BOOM* The ship took a hit. On the top deck, a fighter jet could be seen streaking through the sky, leaving a polluting trail behind it. *BANG* *BANG* one of the smaller ships in the fleet took two consecutive hits and began to sink. Commanders were yelling orders everywhere as the captain tried his best to avoid the enemy missiles. The fleets own missiles were more powerful, but the Sal-Baliz had gained the element of surprise, a very valuable asset indeed.

The battle raged on for hours. Eventually, due to the superiority of their ships, Hydronian forces were able to destroy all Sal-Baliz ships. The jet however was long gone. There are estimated to be no Sal-Baliz survivors, meaning that Etherniastis prisoners are still of the highest value. The UHS odyssey used the little amount of missiles it had left to bombard Sal-Baliz targets, but the damage was minimal compared to the expected impact. The fleet swiftly made its way back to base, the Odyssey towing the smaller ships behind it.

Today the Blarfghanistinian administration announces its possession of our nations very own nuclear arsenal.

[b]Official Statement from the [nation]Sultanate of Orman[/nation][/b]

[b]Ministry of External Affairs[/b]

The [nation]Sultanate of Orman[/nation] expresses concern over the unrest in Sikirsk and offers its sympathy to the affected civilians. Orman firmly opposes military intervention and calls for a peaceful resolution through diplomatic dialogue. We will support humanitarian efforts to provide aid to those in need and encourage all parties to pursue negotiations. Sustainable peace is best achieved through dialogue and mutual respect, not external force.

Amir al-Faisal al-Zahiri
[b]Minister of External Affairs[/b]
[nation]Sultanate of Orman[/nation]

[b]BACKDOORS[/b]
"Dude, what the f*ck?"]
[i]February 20, 2025[/i]
OK, OK. Guys, I need to show you this. I have no idea if I'm tripping on some wild ass sh*t right now, but there is... I don't know how to describe it, but there is is part of my garage room floor where stuff just... it just falls through, like it isn't even there at all! Like, what the f*ck is going on, dude, this doesn't make sense at all?

[i]He sets his phone down on one of many benches in the garage of his house. The room is an absolute mess - piles and piles of trinkets and boxes line the walls, forming a formidable cluster of towers around the single car that managed to fit inside.[/i]

OK, look.

[i]He picks up a small tennis ball on the floor and throws it at a random part of his garage floor. All of a sudden, the ball falls right through the floor, like the concrete is made of air. There is no visible hole at all.[/i]

See? And if you say I'm faking it, I guarantee you, like on GOD, on EVERYTHING, that this is real. H-how is this even possible, man?

[i]He picks up another tennis ball and throws it at his garage floor. It disappears again, phasing through the ground as if an invisible hole of some kind is there.[/i]

[i]March 3, 2025[/i]
I... I think the hole got bigger? I think it's a hole, anyway, but for some reason I can't see it at all. Anyway, look.

[i]He walks in with his phone in hand and films his garage. An entire quarter of it is empty, and one of the car's front wheels are passing through the floor. It looks like reality is glitching, doing something it isn't supposed to do.[/i]

Dude. What the f*ck is happening...

[i]March 15, 2025[/i]
[i]He speaks no words this time. With his phone in hand, he holds it to the mysterious invisible hole in his garage floor and thrusts his hand in. He needs to know what is on the other side of this anomaly.

For a few moments, all his phone can see is pitch black, then, all of a sudden, it is recording the sky, as if it was flying on a plane. Clouds are swirling around in the air. The atmosphere is a deep, vibrant blue. Far down below, all the way down, there is land, cordoned off into large properties of all kinds. It looks like people live there.

He brings his phone back up through the hole, and brings the phone to face him. He ends the recording, so that he can review the footage for himself.[/i]

March 21, 2025
[i]He is filming himself idly throwing trash into his floor out of pure boredom. It phases through the floor every single time.

All of a sudden, he hears a loud rumbling. It sounds like the land is shaking. The sound of wind intensifies, and a huge updraft is blown through his floor.

Then, before he can react, he and everything else in his garage falls through the floor.[/i]
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=*Top Secret Report* Cover Project ]Incident Report: Jakitl Mecu Bean Power Plant Facility
Date: 21 March 2025
Time: 2:21 AM HST-12

Overview:

There was a catastrophic failure during a routine test of the Power Bean experimental energy system, causing a system-wide blackout, crew panic, and a catastrophic incident that was marked by a high-pitched whine and an enormous flash of light. What follows is the transcribed video from the security cameras and audio recordings at the facility:

02:21 AM  Start of Test

Unknown voice: "Okay, listen. We've started the test of Power Bean, and now multiple have confirmed whether everything is ready for the test."

Vict Era: "Operating the system at full capacity.".

Yuris Oman: "Cooling system is ready, sir."

02:30 AM  First Anomalies Observed

Vict Era: "Ahhh. something is trying to tap into the power. Is that? an open hole in the Bean!"

Unknown voice: "Whathuh? What hole? Yuris Oman: "Sir, the hole is slowly growing in the Bean. Our cooling system is starting to get overwhelmed.".

02:38 AM  Rapid Escalation

Unknown voice: "WHAT THE HELL IS HAPPENING? START BRINGING THE BACKUP SYSTEM!"

Computer voice: "It seems there's a fault in the backup system."

Vict Era: "Guys, did the computer just give an error message?"

Unknown voice: "SHUT IT DOWN, NOW!"

Yuris Oman: "Sir, the computer is not responding!

02:49 AM  Hole Widens

Vict Era: "Guys, we have a bigger problem. The hole. it's expanding by the second!

Unknown voice: "Do we have readings? What would be causing this?

Vict Era: "No! We had no sign of this error at the beginning of the test!

02:56 AM  Critical Failure

Unknown voice: "Sound alarms! Report the incident to the state authorities!

(Background murmurs of panic become louder. Alarms start blaring.)

03:06 AM  Explosion

Vict Era: "What. is that noise?" (A loud, shrill sound grows louder, then a bright, blinding flash of light. Explosion sound recorded.) 

End of Recording* 

In the Aftermath of the Jakitl Mecu Bean Power Plant Facility, the beans seemed to build a gateway to a run-down room with old wallpaper. The good thing is that nobody was killed in the test but the result of an earthquake killed about 300 or 400 people. Government officials have focused on covering up the Incidents in the Jakitl Mecu Bean Power Plant Facility. Otherwise, the test had begun a new task of looking into what caused the Incidents. Officials have also begun to rebuild the facility damage and focus on research in the opening dimension hole from another world. [/spoiler]

**OPERATION: NIGHT FERRY**  
**Location:** Secret Compound, Port Verdigo  
**Timestamp:** 03:17 local time

Rain pattered lightly on the concrete as a heavy mist rolled in from the sea. A convoy of three unmarked armored vehicles crept down a side alley in the industrial district of Port Verdigo, headlights off, escorted by a pair of blacked-out scout jeeps. The destination: a secure compound nestled between two derelict warehouses, hidden in plain sight.

Inside the compound, red tactical lights illuminated a small tarmac where a transport plane sat ready, engines humming low. Etherniasti Military Police, clad in urban camo and full tactical gear, formed a tight perimeter around the site.

Three Sal-Baliz prisonersclassified terrorists of high prioritywere blindfolded, handcuffed, and gagged before being ushered out of the lead vehicle. Their identities remain sealed under national security protocol. All are considered directly responsible for mass civilian casualties and acts of terror across Etherniasti-held regions.

They were loaded into the rear bay of the plane without a word. No spotlight, no ceremonyjust silent efficiency under the cover of darkness. Inside, paratroopers stood vigilant, rifles held low but ready, eyes locked on their cargo.

From a mobile command tent nearby, Lieutenant Commander Nyra Vos activated a secure line, her voice calm but firm as she addressed the foreign liaison channel.

"This is Vos. Confirm Hydronia Foreign Security Ministry on the line. We have departed standard channels. These prisoners arrive in Hydronian jurisdiction in T-minus six hours. We need your airfield quiet, your press silent, and your assurances this wont blow back."

There was a delaytoo longand then a clipped response: "Understood. Clearance granted. Well receive them... and ensure they dont slip through."

Vos exhaled, not quite reassured. "We want your word, Hydronia. No interrogations without liaison present. No shadow cells. And our team flies back with that plane."

"Agreed."

It would have to be enough.

As the jet taxied and lifted into the shrouded sky, the city lights of Port Verdigo disappeared below. Only the roar of the engines broke the stillness of the night.

The 3 terrorists were now beyond Etherniasti soiltransferred not just between nations, but into a far murkier arena.

Whatever happened next, it wouldnt be clean.

[nation]United Hydronia[/nation] [nation]Sal-Baliz[/nation]
